pure-announcement.rationale: Although it contains announcement items (Square's integration, a tool promo), the note also carries transferable techniques — the unknowns-surfacing workflows and a complete reusable audit prompt.

duplicate.rationale: The nearest concepts cover export controls, evals and context infrastructure; none cover model-assisted blind-spot discovery or conversion microcopy auditing.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Each item links its primary source — Thariq Shihipar's posted guide, the Pew Research survey, and Square's press release — so a reader can check the claims.

durability.rationale: The blind-spot-pass workflow could outlive the model generation, but the note is padded with expiring specifics — plan-limit dates, Pew adoption percentages, and affiliate tool promos.

actionability.rationale: A reader can immediately run the three named Fable 5 workflows or paste the complete microcopy-audit prompt; these are usable procedures, not product descriptions.

atomicity.rationale: This is a newsletter issue bundling at least four unrelated items — Fable 5 unknowns workflows, Pew adoption stats, a microcopy-audit prompt, and Square/Nitrosend product news — each of which would have to stand alone.
